XHelpers Pro 1.0.37 (55)
- New: ask Look Up follow-up questions. Under GPT-6 Luna's explanation a field is ready for your question as soon as the card shows; press Return to send it. Answers come in the language of your question. Your first question asks for your approval in the card, and Esc still closes Look Up at once. - Capture & Explain takes as many questions as a conversation can hold, each up to 32,000 characters. - Live Subtitles: a notice says when you turn it on or off, the menu lets you choose the language to listen for and, with Translate Subtitles, the language to translate into, and ⌃⌘' turns it on and off. Captions only is the default. - Shelf: Fit Window sizes the window for the number of items you choose, the Shelf opens where and as large as you left it, and its header shows icons only when the window is narrow. - Look Up's word library keeps running when a newer disclosure is available; its card offers the update. - Dictation writes an app's own names correctly where they sound like other words, and the menu lists each profile as its own row. - Pro's windows come forward on their own, and when one closes the keyboard returns to where you were; Dictation's panels and approvals no longer bring Pro's other windows forward. - ⌃⌘Z's black stays after Pro restarts.
